Andrew Pace

Parenting a Young Athlete

Support, without taking over.

A young athlete’s development involves more than training and competition. Parents are also involved in the decisions, the practical organization and the emotional moments that surround a sporting path.

This book looks at that relationship through the question of support: how to remain present while allowing the young person to grow, decide and take ownership of their sport. It is a subject I approach from the athlete’s side of that relationship.
